scripts.lint:python: uv run --locked ruff check . && uv run --locked ruff format --check .
scripts.typecheck:python: uv run --locked --all-packages mypy apps/api/src apps/api/tests packages/contracts/src packages/contracts/tests infra/migrations
scripts.contracts:generate: uv run --locked --all-packages python -m caretrace_api.export_openapi artifacts/openapi.json && pnpm --filter @caretrace/web exec openapi-typescript ../../artifacts/openapi.json --output ../../packages/contracts/generated/api.ts
scripts.contracts:check: pnpm run contracts:generate && git diff --exit-code -- packages/contracts/generated/api.ts
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --locked --all-packages alembic -c infra/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.dev:api: uv run --locked --package caretrace-api uvicorn caretrace_api.main:create_app --factory --reload --reload-dir apps/api/src --host 127.0.0.1 --no-access-log
